Dear wanderers,

Noticing the current exodus we should assure ourselves that internet communities are not chained to one site only, and Reddit's current events have been a spark that demonstrates how powerful we can be if we act together. I don't want to start with an agenda, since we all have to decide what is worth discussing. Whoever wants to give a hand, post your idea and start an exchange of arguments. In the end each and every one of us can choose to agree or not with the statements provided; isn't that wonderful?
